content: {"like": ["The inns are very attractive and the DVD gives a good idea of each inside and out.", "Discussions with the owners provide historical and other information.", "The host, Judith Moen, is elegant and gracious without seeming pompous or stuffy.", "The show provides variety by visiting a good number of other sites and showing scenery in each area.", "Camerawork is well done.", "The picture quality is decent, and the image was not unacceptable even on a 50-inch HD TV.", "The runtime is generous at 1 hour 45 minutes.", "The reviewer wanted to travel to New England in person, preferably with Judith as a guide."], "dislike": []}
